The on-chain action is a plain ERC-20 transfer, which matches the description, so rule 10 does not require abstention. The description also admits the root cause is an unresolved recurring shortfall, and the mandate's priority is treasury protection, so the transfer outflow weighs against it. Confidence is moderately high because the mandate's threshold is close to the amount and the treasury share is not stated.
